name: comebye-hub
description: Comebye in Claude Code: a status band above the prompt, instant /todo /handoff /show commands (no model turn) and warn-only guard notices.

own_owners.title: Your GitHub owners
own_owners.description: Comma-separated GitHub users and orgs you push to. A git push to any other owner gets a warning. Empty: warn only for a remote named upstream.

poll_seconds.title: Band refresh (seconds)
poll_seconds.description: How often the band asks Comebye for its state; 30 or more.
